name: Mamanoue Yuno
source:
[b]Your Childhood Friend, the Campus Princess[/b]

[i]“Please don’t call me ‘Princess’… It’s embarrassing! Just ‘Yuno’ is fine.”[/i]

The girl you’ve known since childhood is now your classmate and the academy’s beloved “Princess.” As the [url=/c117034]chairman[/url]'s granddaughter, she’s mastered the art of appearing graceful and refined in public. But you know the real Yuno—a cheerful, energetic girl who’d rather binge sports highlights than sit through an opera.

Hobby: Opera appreciation (secretly a sports fanatic)
Favorite food: Gâteau au chocolat (her true love is takoyaki)
Relationship goal: [i]“I’d be happy if we could always be together.”[/i]

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/sts2/index.html#yuno]the official website[/url]]

In [url=https://vndb.org/v47676]Fandisc[/url]: Height: 156cm, B93-W57-H87cm, G cup
